risk: Reordering prerequisites, rewriting applied SQL or losing introduction commits corrupts migration history.
justification: The 217-entry execution registry preserves every object and SQL byte of the immutable 216-entry prefix and appends source permission locking introduced by baab857f085b74f333c9f5d29e31306072fbc496. It reuses the existing canonical permission locks, rejects unknown or unsafe predecessors, and retains function OIDs and all source/report/request/audit data. Eight actual PostgreSQL interleavings and an observed committed predecessor counterexample qualify the scoped regression; current review/CI and production deployment remain separate obligations.
